arguments.message:
If your workspace’s SSO configuration is pointing to an identity‑provider domain you don’t recognise, it’s likely been changed unintentionally (or maliciously). An admin who still has access should:

1. Open **Settings → Security → SSO**.
2. Either disable the SSO integration or change the configuration so it points back at the correct identity‑provider.
3. Save the changes.
4. Immediately report the change to Meridian support so a reviewer can audit when and how the setting was altered and which account made the change.

This will stop users from being redirected to the wrong location and let the team investigate the cause.
